name: Bijnor

queries.query: Bijnor Uttar Pradesh official cadastral parcel map bhu naksha land records GIS
queries.result: Found official UP Bhulekh cadastral digitization dashboard, official UP BhuNaksha login/frontend, and official Bijnor district site. The dashboard is Bijnor-specific but does not expose parcel geometry in the public response.

queries.result: Search found the same official UP Revenue Council/UP Bhulekh and BhuNaksha services. Hindi search results identify Bhu-Naksha/शजरा and खसरा services, but no anonymous Bijnor parcel geometry endpoint was exposed.

registryBasis: The Government of Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh public digitization dashboard is district- and tehsil-scoped to Bijnor and reports cadastral-map digitization fields. The UP Revenue Council portal identifies भू-नक्शा/शजरा and गाटा boundary services. This evidences the relevant state/local land-records custodian, not an open parcel API.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Government of Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh / Revenue Council
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Public Bijnor district report lists Bijnor tehsil and digitization counts; Bijnor tehsil row reports 553 villages, 527 scanned/verified/linked villages, 526 geo-referenced villages, and 551 scanned/verified/linked mapsheets with 550 geo-referenced mapsheets. This is coverage metadata only, not parcel geometry.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Government of Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh / Revenue Council
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Public Bijnor tehsil report returned village rows with safe aggregate/digitization flags and village codes. It did not return parcel polygons or a map-service URL for the WUP point.
Current frontend exposes district option बिजनौर (code 134), but the visible workflow is user login with username, password and CAPTCHA. No login or CAPTCHA was attempted.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: District Bijnor, Government of Uttar Pradesh
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official district site identifies Bijnor district and links Land Records in its public information navigation; no machine-readable parcel layer was found in the inspected page.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Uttar Pradesh state land-records cadastral digitization dashboard with Bijnor district and tehsil coverage metadata; current BhuNaksha application advertises district/tehsil/village map levels.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Bijnor district and Bijnor tehsil digitization metadata only; no open parcel geometry was verified.

blocker: No anonymous parcel geometry and stable native parcel identity were obtained. The current UP BhuNaksha workflow is login/CAPTCHA-gated, and two advertised anonymous bootstrap routes timed out on bounded retry. The public UP Bhulekh dashboard provides only digitization metadata.
remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point was not shifted and was not used to infer absence. Bijnor city urban coverage, map extent, CRS, parcel schema, and safe native parcel identity remain unverified.
nextStep: When the official public workflow is reachable without authentication, follow its ordinary selected-level requests for Bijnor city/tehsil and request only bounded geometry plus native parcel IDs; otherwise obtain a documented official geometry-only export.
